manifest_row.title: UK's Heathrow airport begins appeal against expansion block

screening.main_topic: Heathrow's appeal against the block on its runway expansion plans
screening.climate_relevance: The court blocked the expansion on environmental grounds, citing the need to account for the UK's climate commitments. Heathrow's appeal and its defense of the project directly address compliance with carbon-reduction obligations and the Paris Agreement.
screening.reason: Although the article focuses on a legal appeal over airport expansion, climate obligations are a substantial part of the dispute and the airport's stated case.
